title: Love, Theoretically
author: Ali Hazelwood
summary: Elle is a physics adjunct who pays the bills by being a fake girlfriend for hire. Her two lives collide when the older brother of a client turns out to be the academic rival who could decide her career.
readIf: you like banter-heavy academic romances with steam and a lot of science jokes.
skipIf: you prefer romance with little explicit content or a more realistic view of academia.
